text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Net income for the 12 months ended December 31, 1996, includes extraordinary and one-time charges of $0.60 a share. Net income for the 12 months ended December 31, 1995 includes a one-time charge of $0.10 a share.
As of December 31, 1996, total number of shares outstanding was 36,802,484.
